content: Jesús dulapaa-gakambe (70) e-sapingan-barmisad
Deyob we-ibmar-gusad-sorba, Jesús e-sapingan-baigan e-dulapaa-gakambe (70), bela na e-naoed-neggweburmarse ebo-ebo e-iduar barmisad.

Jesús amarga sogded: “Napira an bemarga soged, nainugi ibmar-gwag-weleged bukidarad, ar e-weemaladdina ichee gued. Degisoggu, nainugi ibdula-gwag-weleged-e-ibedse be wilesakwaa egismar, adi, e-nainuse ibdula-gwag-wemalad-barmidagegar.
”Be namar, sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwadyob, achu-burburmalad-abargi, an bemar barmidmar.
Mer mor-sagu sedmalo, mani-sagu surbar, degi, sapat surbar, degine, melle igarba dule-absomarbalo.
”Ar doa-negse be dogdapmalale, agi bina be soggweloed: ‘We-neggi bemar gwage-bogidikidgi gudigusunye.’
”Ar a-neggine dule-gwage-bogidikidgi-nanaed maile, be-ega-sogsadyob a-dulegi gwage-bogidikidi beoed. Ar degisulirdi, ega-be-sogsadyob gwen guosulid.
Bemar unnila neg-gwagwenginbi be gabmaloed. Degine, ibu bemarga gunnega, gobega ukarmardibe, be gunno, be gobo. Ar ade, dule-arbaedi bennuklegergebed. Mer neg-baid-baidgi gabdii gumalo.
”Ar biti-neggweburse be dogdapmardibe, agine, be-abingasmalale, ibi-masgunned bega ukarmalale, be gunnoed.
A-neggweburgi dule-gegumaladi be nudakoed, degine, dulemarga be sogoed: ‘Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bemarse warmaksasunye.’
”Ar biti-neggweburse be dogdapmardibe, agine be-abingassurmalale, be e-galimbaba noalidgi, be sogmaloed:

‘Be-neggwebur-olli-anmar-sapatgi-nagusadse-bakar, anmar elimarsun. We oyoged, bemarginye, bemar yapa Bab-Dummad-igar-abingamaladye. Degi-inigwele, be wisgumalo, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bemarse warmaksad.’
”Ani, Jesús, an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabogoed-ibagangi, neggwebur-be-abingaosulid, Sodoma-neggweburba bur bule sabsur-odurdaklegoed.”
Jesús neggweburmar-sabsur-odurdaklegoedgi sunmaksad

Jesús sogdebar: “¡Corazín-dorgan be duledar-wilesmar! ¡Betsaida-dorgan be duledar-wilesmar! Ar bemar sabsur-odurdaklenonikoed. Ar Tiro-neggweburgi, degi, Sidón-neggweburgi we-ibmar-dakledisurmalad imaklesana, a-neggweburmar bato dikasurgus sagumor-ai-aid yosmalanad, degine, burugi obsamarbalinad, adi, oyogegar, emarde, na e-isguedga bukib ulubgi nue-itosmarye.
Degisoggu, an bemarga sogsun, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabogoed-ibagangi, bemar bur bule Tiro-dorganba, degi, Sidón-dorganba sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.
”Emide, bemar Capernaúm-dorgan, ¿nibneggi, nued abingalegoye be binsamala? Suli. Aka be nega-uluba odurdakleged-negse be balimelledmaloed.”

Jesús, dulapaa-gakambe-barminaidga (70) sogdebar: “Ar dulemar be-itomalale, an-ega-ibmar-soged-itonaiyob gumalodo. Ar dulemar be-abingasurmalale, an-abingasurmalayob gumalodo. Ar dulemar an-abingasulile, dule-an-barmialid-abingasurmardo.”
Jesús-sapingan gannar Jesúsʼse nonikid
Jesús e-dulapaa-gakambe-barmisadi (70), gannar nonimargu, ise-weligwar-ito nonimalad, Jesúsʼga sognonimalad: —Dummad, niamarse-bakar, be-nuggine anmar-sogedba ibmar imaksamalad.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Mer be na san-dummarba itomalo. Nia-saila-Satanás, mar-gaedyob nibneggi argwannali an daksad.”

Jesús e-sapinganga sogdebar: “Emide, bemarga gangued an uked, naibemar-birgi, degine, diormar-birgi annaegar. Degine, bela be-isdarad-Satanás-ganguedgi-nakwega bemarga gangued an uked. Amar gwen be-oakalogosurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, niaburbamar bemar-sogedba ibmar-imakedgi mer be weligwar itomar. Bur be bemar-nug-nibneggi-narmakar-naid-ular be wergumar.”
Jesús nue-weligwar itosad

Geb agi Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledba nue-weligwar ito naded, sogded: “Baba, an be-nug odummosun. Bedi, nibneg-e-dummadid, napneg-e-dummadid, degine, bedi, dulemar-ibmar-wismalad-idu, dulemar-ibmar-magar-itomalad-idu, we-ibmarmar odukusad, aku-ito be imaksad. Dulemar-baisursunnagwadga bur be osanalosad, adi, amar magar itomalagar. Eye, Baba, ar ade, deyob be abesad.”

Jesús sogdebar: “Bela-ibmarmar an-Bab anga uksad. Dulemar wargwensaar Bab-Dummad-Machi-mag-daked satemalad, unnila Bab-Dummadbi mag daked, degi, Bab-Dummad-akudakmarbalid. Unnila E-Machibi mag Bab-daked, ar doaga E-Machi na e-Bab-osanalobie, agarbi na osanaloged.”
Jesús na e-sapinganse aibilidgu, amargarbi sogded: “Dulemar bemar-ibmar-dakedyob-dakmarmogadgi egi ise-nued binsalesad.

Ar ani an bemarga sogmalad, bukidar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, degi, reymar, emi-bemar-ibmar-daked, dakbigusmalanad, amar gwen daksasurmalad, degi, amar emi-bemar-ibmar-itoged, itobigusmalanad, amar gwen itossurmalad.”
Samaria-dule-nuedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Agine, Moisés-Igar-Mamaid-oduloged-wargwen, gwisgualid, Jesús-yardakega yamo sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿burba-geg-bergued an nikuegala, ibu an imakergebe?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidgi igi narmakar maisunna? ¿Igi be absodisunna?
A-dule, abin-imakdegu, sogded:
Deuteronomio 6:5

content.text: ” ‘Ar igi na be san-sabgue, deyobi dule-baid be sabgumogoed.’ ”

content: Levítico 19:18
Jesús aga sogded: —Nued be an-abin-imaksad. Ar be sogsadyob be imakdo, geb agi be degisadegu dula gudiguoed.
Ar Moisés-Igar-Maid-oduloged-nue-wisid na dukin dule-nuedga-imakbisoggu, Jesúsʼga sogded: —¿Degite, doa-dule-baid an sabguergebsunna?

Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: “Ibagwengi, dule-wargwen Jericó-neggweburse, Jerusalén-neggweburgi aidedani gusad. Igarba danigu, atursamalad-argangi gusad. Atursamalad sarsosmargu, bela ei ibmar susmalad, burgwedani mete nadmalad.
”Dakargu, Judío-wargwen, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, a-igarba aidedani gusad. Dule-naibigus-mellemaid-daksagu, egi bakar nasad.
”Amba deyob Judío-baid, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-e-bendaked-Levita-dule, dule-naibigus-maid-walikgusgu, daksamogu, egi bakar nasa gusmogad.
”Ar dule-wargwen, Samariaʼgined, igarba nadapmogu, dule-naibigus-maid-daknonimogad. Ar we-dule, Judíoʼsur-inigwele, dule-naibigus-maid-dakdegu, nue-wile dakded.

Samariaʼgined dule-naibigus-maidse-warmakdapgu, e-nailikgusmaladgi ega ina imaksad, ibmar-gwallu, degi, vino, egi eosad. Geb degi, ega nue-morgogi edichabalid. Geb moli-uayasuid-birgi-onakwisa meged-negse senonikid. Agi nue-akwisad.

”A-banedgine, Samariaʼgined nasokargu, mani-gwabo onosad. Neg-dakedga mani uksad, geb ega sogded: ‘Nue we-dule be anga ako. Degine, igi-mani-napi egi be misale, gannar an aibilisar, an be-bennuknonikoed.’ ”
Moisés-Igar-Maid-oduloged-nue-wisidga Jesús sogded: —Be itogua, we-dulemar-e-warbaagwad ¿doa bur dule-nailikgusad sabedgi bendas be itosunna?

Moisés-Igar-Maid-oduloged-nue-wisid Jesúsʼga sogded: —Ar dule bur-nue dule-nailikgusad-wile-daksad, a-dule, bur dule-baid nue-sabgusdo. Geb degi, Jesús ega sogded: —Igi-Samariaʼgined dule-baid-bendaksad, deyob be imaknamosundo.
Jesús, Martaʼse, degi, Maríaʼse atakapid
Jesús na e-sapinganmala igarba nadapgu, neggwebur-gwensakse dogdapid. A-neggweburgi ome-wargwen, Martaʼye-nugadi, e-neggi Jesús-abindaksad.
We-omede urba-nikad, Maríaʼye-nugad. María, Jesús-walik sigisad, Jesús-ibmar-odurdaked itosii gusad.
Ar Martaʼdi ibmar-saedginbi binsanaisoggu, obir-obir gunaid. Marta, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, an-urba wargwen arbaega-an-imaknaid ¿be baisur dake? Ega be soge, wis an-bendakye.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Marta, Marta, ibmar-imakedba be surbinsa itonaid, obir-obir be itonaid.
Ar unnila ibmar-soggwenbi bur-nuedid. Ar Maríaʼdi ibmar-soggwen-bur-nued susad, an-sunmaked-itoged. A-ibmar Maríaʼgi gwen egwallegosulid.
